# AmberX AXF

- **Name** (hub folder `/projects/amberx-axf`): `amberx-axf`
- **Description:** Cross-platform app framework where every UI piece is a hot-swappable JSON asset (asset@1). Web port (TypeScript reference engines + React) and Android port (Kotlin/Compose, pure-Kotlin kernel); Python port planned.
- **Repo:** https://github.com/MossesX/AmberX-AXF (private, default branch `main`)
- **Kind:** framework · **status:** active · **version:** 0.2.0
- **Deploy:** demo https://axf.amberxai.com · console https://console.amberxai.com · via coolify
- **Owner:** GitHub `MossesX` (Brett)
